sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: By default, Mythical Void stores your creatures, progress, and preferences locally on your device using browser localStorage. If you explicitly enable optional Cloud Save, a versioned copy of your game progress, an anonymous account identifier, and save timestamps are sent to our Supabase database so your progress can be recovered. Cloud Save is disabled by default. If an eligible 16+ profile chooses personalized living media, bounded creature traits and an optional pixel-creature reference image are sent for image generation. A protected Living Portrait may then be used as the visual reference for a short personalized story video. The player-given creature name is not included in either request. An optional adult feedback pulse stores only fixed-choice answers, the submission time and the current release identifier. It does not ask for a name, email address, free-text answer, exact age or child details.

sections.heading: Local Storage
sections.content:
Your primary game save is stored in your browser's localStorage. This means:
• No account or login is required to play
• Clearing browser data can delete local-only saves
• The game remains playable if Cloud Save is unavailable
• Cloud synchronization occurs only after you explicitly enable it

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.content:
Mythical Void uses the following external services:
• Supabase: When Cloud Save, eligible personalized living media or the adult feedback pulse is used, Supabase provides anonymous authentication, private storage, database storage or fixed-choice feedback storage and maintains security and service logs.
• Replicate: For an eligible 16+ request, Replicate processes bounded creature appearance traits and an optional pixel-creature reference image to create a Living Portrait. That protected portrait may be used as the reference for a short story video. We do not send the player-given creature name, email address, location, or account credentials to either model.
• NASA APIs: We fetch publicly available astronomical images and data. No game profile is sent to NASA.
• Netlify: Our game and protected application functions are hosted on Netlify, which maintains standard server access logs such as IP addresses and timestamps.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Mythical Void is designed for players of all ages, including children. No account is required and local play remains available without Cloud Save. Cloud Save and personalized external AI features are unavailable to profiles that identify as under 16 in this release. The selected age range stays on the device. We do not intentionally request a child's email address, exact birth date, or physical location. The separate feedback pulse is only for adults aged 18 or over. It uses fixed choices, does not request child details, and rejects a submission unless the adult confirmation is selected.

sections.heading: Adult Feedback
sections.content: The optional adult feedback pulse requires an adult confirmation and records six fixed-choice answers, the submission time and the current release identifier. It does not create an account or store a name, email address, free-text answer, exact age, user or session identifier, creature name, device detail or location in the feedback record. The fixed-choice record is kept for no more than 180 days and is available only to the protected server role. Standard Netlify and Supabase service and security logs remain subject to their own operational retention.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.content: Local saves remain under your device's control. Optional cloud saves are protected through authenticated access and database policies that restrict each player to their own record. Living Portrait and personalized story-video files are copied into private storage; save files contain protected asset references rather than storage paths or expiring access links. Guardian PIN data and local safety audit history are excluded from cloud uploads. You can disable Cloud Save without deleting the existing copy, or delete the remote save, protected living media, and anonymous cloud identity from the in-game settings.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy as the game develops. Material changes to data collection or Cloud Save will be presented before the affected feature is enabled. The 'Last Updated' date identifies the current version.
